title: Cross-Dressing
paragraphs: “Geez…”
Ah, Father is leaning away from me even though I leaned in close to him. And of all things, he’s picked up Rival and floated her out the window.
“Well then, I’ll head back with Gaelion-chan first and help Rishia and the others get ready, so Itsuki… are you and Motoyasu-kun going to do anything at school?”
“Absolutely not! Please take Motoyasu-san home with you properly!”
“Hmm… he seems to be in some kind of weird mode. Maybe he’s just doing something like his hometown vibe applied to the school atmosphere? Give it some time and he might adapt just fine?”
“No thank you! If Motoyasu-san stays here, it’ll only lead to more bizarre incidents! No more duels, no more shadow battles, no more magic fights! Please, take Motoyasu-san home too!”

Oh my? Father’s response is rather cold. Ah, I see—perhaps he prefers an Older Sister-type character over an Older Brother-type. Very well, let me analyze this from the angle of a reliable older sister route.
“Then I shall cross-dress and guide both Father and Itsuki as a reliable older sister figure, I say.”
“Where on earth is that idea even coming from? Motoyasu-kun’s gone off the rails… maybe it’s time to send him back to the village for a bit.”
“Please, genuinely take him home!”
“Still, Itsuki. Be careful staying overnight at school. Watch out for pig ambushes, indeed.”
“Yeah, yeah.”
“May my New Nambu not breathe fire—”
Itsuki opened fire on me at high speed, so I dodged by running along the wall, I say.
“Hahaha! Itsuki’s little popgun can’t touch me, I say!”
“Tch! Being dodged is humiliating. I won’t let you escape!”
Quick-draw shooting may be Itsuki’s specialty, but I am several steps ahead, indeed!
“I dunno, but this whole shootout action between Motoyasu-kun and Itsuki looks like it’d be pretty impressive on camera.”
“Focus on the action and turn him into a movie actor—that could work, nano.”

“Ahh… I mean, even if he can’t hold a conversation with women, Motoyasu-kun’s face alone could probably get popular. He’d just need to say his lines as scripted, and in that case, maybe we get Yuki-chan to play the heroine role? Itsuki wouldn’t act, just handle direction.”
“What kind of project are you two dreaming up?! Just take Motoyasu-san home already! Honestly…”
“Yeah, yeah. Motoyasu-kun. Time to go home~”
“Understood, I say!”
And so, Father and I returned to the village for the time being, I say.
“Now then, we’ve returned, but that doesn’t change the fact that Father is exhausted, I say.”
Back in the village, Father went to check on Riska and the others’ preparations for enrollment, so I decided to act independently, indeed.
“Yuki-chan, are you there?”
Let me pay a visit to Yuki-chan’s room in the village and get her help with the operation.
“Motoyasu-sama! Welcome back, indeed!”

Somehow or other, Yuki-chan has entered various races, and by winning while singing and dancing, she’s become something of an idol in the Filolial racing world, I say. When she’s in the village, she’s free to act and rest as she pleases, indeed. With a major race coming up soon, she must be tired, I say.
“Yuki-chan, I’ve decided to take some action regarding Itsuki’s matter, but do you have plans tonight? No need to push yourself, I say.”
“It’s fine, indeed. If I recall, Motoyasu-sama went with Naofumi-sama to check on the Bow Hero’s condition, didn’t you?”

“Indeed. Father and Itsuki said I didn’t need to come along, but if I properly and thoroughly complete the task of helping them here, I can make a grand appeal that I am far more capable than Rival, I say.”

During the cooking showdown, Rival didn’t even show up, but Ren and Father himself stole all the glory. This time, I shall gather solid intelligence, securing clues that will prove useful should a similar situation arise. I cannot keep letting Rival hog all the credit forever, indeed.
“Filoko heard everything, kyu!”
At this point, Filoko-chan came bursting in.
“Filoko-chan is supposed to be helping Fleon-chan. Whatever could be the matter, I say?”
“For reasons, Filoko can’t get involved in this matter, but Filoko’s cheering you on, kyu. Cheering super hard, kyu.”
“Just cheering me on and that’s it…? What is that supposed to mean?”
Yuki-chan tilted her head in confusion, but being cheered on only fills me with even more motivation, I say.

“For now, Yuki-chan, tonight I’ll be infiltrating the magic school, so I need you to wait somewhere safe nearby and use this ultra-compact microphone-equipped ribbon to constantly translate pig-speak for me, indeed.”

Since Ren and Itsuki wouldn’t hand over those mysterious badges they had, I commissioned Faubrey’s technology research institute to make me a similar bugging device, indeed. It’s an upgraded version of the badge, packed with even more functions. If I use this well, I can conduct infiltration activities even in a school crawling with pigs. But merely gathering intelligence while concealed has its limits on what information I can obtain, so I shall infiltrate in disguise as well, indeed.
“Since Filoko-chan can’t help this time, tonight I can only entrust this to the ever-diligent Yuki-chan, I say.”
“Understood, indeed! This Yuki shall assist Motoyasu-sama with all her might, indeed!”
Yuki-chan answered my request looking positively delighted.
“For now, then… to start with…”
Just as I was about to prepare a costume for my disguise, Filoko-chan’s back popped open—not into microphone mode, but into a state with several arms extended, indeed.
“Filoko will help make the outfit, kyu. What kind of costume do you want, kyu?”
“Why, of course—”
Swiftly, swiftly, I sketched out the design I’d use for this mission, indeed. Filoko-chan then prepared fabric matching the design and cut it to just the right proportions.
“Filoko can help Fleon’s… help the Filolials shine, kyu! Something this simple is a piece of cake, and with the Spear Hero’s input, any costume can be made, kyu!”
“Ohh! Splendid, I say!”
Dadada! In a flash, Filoko-chan’s sewing machine completed the costume I’d designed, indeed.
“Alright, to start, operation commence, I say! Yuki-chan. Time for a live field test, indeed! Kweh!”
“Kweh! Indeed!”
“Kweh! Kyu!”
And so, I donned the completed outfit, disguised myself thoroughly, and… as a first step, made my return to the magic school, indeed.

It was not quite the dead of night when even the grass and trees sleep… no, nothing so dramatic. It was nighttime at the magic school, the hour before bed, indeed. I had Yuki-chan wait outside the school grounds while I strode elegantly into the schoolyard, indeed.
“As expected of Motoyasu-sama, indeed! Yuki, Yuki also wants to learn to walk as elegantly as Motoyasu-sama, indeed.”
From beyond the wall, Yuki-chan tested the microphone as I walked through the schoolyard.
“It’s not so difficult, I say. Old skills die hard, indeed.”
I continued straight on, walking through the school building toward Itsuki’s room, indeed.
“Ah…”

I passed a male student, but he showed no sign of alarm, merely staring at me, indeed. Fufufu, even infiltrating this boldly, no one suspects an intruder. No need even for something like a Cloaking Lance, indeed. Easy work. And so, turning a corner… the pigs, despite it being nighttime, hadn’t returned to their dormitories and were oinking away. The magic school employs a fair amount of appropriate technology, so lights can be kept on indoors even at night, indeed. Through that, I proceeded elegantly, indeed.
“Buhya, bubu—”
“Buu…”
The pigs having that conversation stopped the moment they saw me, and like the male student before, they turned toward me with—no, rather unpleasant stares. I ignored them and walked past, indeed.
“Huh? Who’s that? But… yeah. Really gorgeous, is what a woman’s voice said in the distance, indeed.”
“Much appreciated for the translation, I say.”
I replied to Yuki-chan in a low voice, indeed. Now then… I’ve arrived at my destination, Itsuki’s room, indeed. Ahem… knock knock, I rapped on Itsuki’s door, indeed.
“…Yes. Honestly… I’ve lost count of how many people this is, but who is it? If it’s about something unclear from class, or thoughts on a song, I’ll respond during tomorrow’s lesson—”
Itsuki said this while opening the door, so I stepped back slightly and raised one hand in greeting, indeed.

“Bow Hero-sama, thank you most sincerely for gracing the magic school with your presence this time. I feared that today, being approached by so many students of the school, would trouble you greatly, so I refrained from speaking up, but I have come now to pay my respects.”
I elegantly lifted the hem of my skirt and offered a polite greeting, indeed.
“U-um… so what business do you have with me?”
“Tonight, I wish to help drive out the foolish pi— persons who scheme wicked things against Bow Hero-sama. That is why I have come to speak with you.”
Whew, that was close, I nearly said “pig,” indeed.
“Ah… another one pretending to be an ally this time…”
Itsuki’s guard has gone up, indeed. Just as planned.

“Perish the thought. I am not a supporter of Bow Hero-sama, but rather of Sh— the Shield Hero-sama and the Filolial-sa— the Filolials. Should someone from our school commit some indecent act against Bow Hero-sama, it may crush the chances of Shield Hero-sama’s visit, and so I wish to cooperate.”
“So you’re a fan of Naofumi-san… but he has a wife and kids, you know?”
“Becoming his lover is not the only path, indeed. I simply wish for him to visit the school, and I shall spare no effort in cooperating toward that end.”
“I see… well, if you’re being this frank about it, I suppose that helps, but what exactly will you be doing?”
Itsuki asked, seeming not quite convinced.
“About that… Itsuki, your guard is far, far too lax, indeed.”
Here, I switched off the voice-changer function on my small microphone to issue a warning, indeed.
“Huh?”
Itsuki responded with a stunned expression as my voice suddenly changed while scolding him.

“Pigs are vile creatures who fabricate all manner of reasons to draw close and then strike, indeed. Cooperation because of some other motive? Behind that lies one pretending to be an ally so as to target and attack you, indeed. This is precisely the tactic favored by the shadowy mastermind who pretends to side with the bullied!”
“No… that’s not it, it’s your voice and way of speaking… don’t tell me—Motoyasu-san!?”
Itsuki snapped back to himself and pointed at me, indeed.
“Indeed! Well, how about it? My cross-dressing and voice-altering technique, I say!”

My current appearance was a faithful recreation of the disguise I once used to enroll incognito, hiding my identity as a man in a school full of pigs, indeed. Since I’d already been growing my hair out, I stopped tying it up and styled it with glossy conditioner, applied makeup, and worked hard to make my shoulders appear as slim as possible, indeed. They’re a bit hunched, but it’ll do, indeed. My chest is properly secured with a bra to keep an acceptable shape. And I made and wore this school’s girls’ uniform together with Filoko-chan, then walked in elegantly, indeed.
“No… now that I look closely, I can tell it’s Motoyasu-san, but what is wrong with you?! Do you have disguise skills rivaling Shadow’s?!”
Ah, Shadow the pig, indeed. That one can transform into a perfect likeness of Fiancée, but I could tell the difference, I say.

“What is that mysterious talent, or ability, or whatever?! I feel like I’ve heard of it before, but if you can pull it off this well, then yeah, no one would notice. I have to say, honestly, that’s impressively skilled.”
Itsuki nodded as if convinced, indeed. How about that?
“Wait, is Naofumi-san here too?! Are you both here just messing around?! Gaelion-san! Please stop teasing me already!”
Itsuki looked around nervously, casting about with skills or spells meant to break concealment and pinpoint locations, indeed.
“Father and Rival are not here, I say! I have come alone, on my own initiative, and without warning, to give Itsuki a piece of my mind, indeed!”

“I was on guard because only someone at Gaelion-san’s or a Hero’s level could’ve located me, but to think you’d come straight at me from the front… why would you go through such elaborate trouble— no, you actually came to carry out what you said before we left, didn’t you!”
Itsuki lamented, glancing at me over and over, indeed. What is with that look, I wonder?
“Taller than me, and just when I thought the most stunning beauty I’ve ever seen had shown up, it turns out to be this…”
Itsuki slumped his shoulders in dejection, but that just shows his guard is too lax, indeed.

“And so, Itsuki, your vigilance is far too soft, indeed. When a pig comes to your door, the correct action is to fling it open and subdue it without question, I say! And what’s more, coming here on your very first day with no teacher present—an instant disqualification, indeed!”
“Why am I the one getting a lecture from you, the one who committed the crime here?!”
“Pigs will worm their way in given the slightest opening, indeed. If you’re not careful, they’ll quite literally pluck the bullets clean out of your New Nambu, indeed!”
“Just be quiet! Ugh, honestly… why didn’t you bring Naofumi-san with you?! Oh right, you came without consulting anyone. One of these days I really will shoot you dead!”
“Yuki is standing by too, indeed!”
Yuki-chan’s voice came through the microphone, indeed.
“Sigh… is this like the time you tried to recruit me into the shadow culinary world, trying to rack up points without troubling Naofumi-san?”
“Say whatever you like, I say. What do you think? What mere covert surveillance alone cannot uncover, I have come to assist by disguising myself like this, indeed.”
When it comes to school life, I daresay no one surpasses me, indeed.
“Say, why exactly did you come to this world and end up as the Spear Hero again?”
Guh… Itsuki, you little… he struck right at my most tender spot, indeed.
Please look forward to the new series, “The Monster Tamer’s Reverse Fortune,” as well.
